# function: tenant_config

Builds the TenantConfig message from an object and returns its protojson encoding, the value `authwise_tenant_config.config` takes: the same string `data.authwise_tenant_config` exposes as `json` for the same arguments, with the same attributes and checks. Requires Terraform 1.8 or later.

Use it in place of the data source to keep plans quiet. Terraform reads a data source at apply whenever a resource named in its arguments has a change planned, so `authwise_tenant_config.config` plans an update that applies as a no-op; this function is evaluated at plan whenever its argument is known.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "authwise_tenant_config" "this" {
  config = provider::authwise::tenant_config({
    access_token_expire_seconds  = 900
    refresh_token_expire_seconds = 1209600

    branding = {
      logo_asset_id = authwise_asset_content.logo.asset_id
    }
  })
}
```

## Signature

<!-- signature generated by tfplugindocs -->
```text
tenant_config(config dynamic) string
```

## Arguments

<!-- arguments generated by tfplugindocs -->
1. `config` (Dynamic) An object with the attributes of `data.authwise_tenant_config`, snake_case as there. Unset attributes are left out.
